fields.description: The measure's business name, and the row's own name - "Gross Revenue", "Units Sold". One definition per name, site-wide.
fields.label: Metric

fields.description: The document this measure is read from. Certified, its words become evidence for that document in retrieval.
fields.label: Document

fields.description: The column the aggregate is applied to. Required for every aggregate except `Count`, which counts rows.
fields.label: Fieldname

fields.description: How the column becomes one number.
fields.label: Aggregate
fields.options:
Sum
Count
Distinct Count
Average
Min
Max

fields.description: The measure in a sentence a person would say. This is what makes the row worth more than the column it names.
fields.label: Definition

fields.description: Which rows count, in plain words - "submitted only, excluding returns". Documentation for a person and for a model; nothing compiles it.
fields.label: Filters

fields.description: What one unit of this measure describes - "per invoice", "per item line".
fields.label: Grain

fields.description: Other words for this measure, so that "turnover" can find the document that holds revenue.
fields.label: Synonyms

fields.description: Who owns this definition. A measure nobody owns is a measure nobody trusts.
fields.label: Steward

fields.description: Only a certified measure is evidence: retrieval reads certified rows and ignores drafts, so an in-progress definition cannot move an answer.
fields.label: Certified
